title: Curated cancer-gene variant pack from CIViC (CC0), hg38+hg19
context: CIViC (Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer) is a CC0-licensed community-curated database of cancer variant evidence, making it one of the clearest Priority-A sources for redistribution. Framed as research evidence (not clinical advice), a CIViC variant track overlaid on cancer gene models is high-value for researchers and educators who want to see where curated evidence variants sit along the genome. This pack demonstrates M1 multi-browser parity (all three targets) and the hg19 liftOver path on a real Priority-A source.
objective: Build the CIViC curated variant pack on hg38 (primary) and hg19 (via liftOver), emitting all three browser targets (UCSC + JBrowse 2 + IGV), with per-feature provenance to CIViC record IDs and provenance completeness ≥ 90/100.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is CIViC (CC0); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true; pack is framed as research evidence and carries an explicit not-medical-advice notice — never as clinical advice.
Built on hg38 and lifted to hg19 with recorded chain provenance and committed unmapped report.

All three browser targets emitted (UCSC hub + JBrowse 2 config.json + IGV session) and render-verified in at least one target browser; features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/pack-011.json.
Per-feature provenance records CIViC variant IDs, source release version, and license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence recorded or adoption blocker surfaced in outcomes/pack-011.json.
resources: CIViC API and bulk download (CC0): https://civicdb.org/
output: output/packs/civic-variants-hg38/ and output/packs/civic-variants-hg19/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/pack-011.json.
